title: Overview
subtitle: Keys, client tokens, and recent Tavily usage

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.subtitle: Complete these three steps to start serving MCP requests.

step1.title: Add an API key
step1.description: Add your Tavily or Brave API key. The gateway uses it for every upstream search call.

step2.title: Mint a client token
step2.description: Create a scoped token for your MCP client. Set expiry, allowed tools, and rate limit.

step3.title: Test a tool
step3.description: Use the Playground to fire a live MCP request with your token and confirm results.
